title: Weaving Waters
short_description: Open the doors to your soul with your own voice and let the waters move through during this water journey. 🌊
description:
Open the doors to your soul with your own voice and let the waters move through during this water journey. 🌊

In this afternoon we connect ourselves with our inner and outer waters in various ways. 💃🏼 There is space for all which lies between tears & laughter by dancing, singing & listening. So whatever wants to flow can flow. 🙏🏼We welcome you as you are.

🩵 Flow
15:00 Doors are open
15:15 Welcome & opening
15:30 Vocal Expression 🌬️
16:30 Water Ceremony
18:00 Food & rest Nourishment 🥗
19:00 Concert of Lena & Birdy
20:30 Closure

🌳 Our water journey unfolds in the Shala of Essência, nestled in a magical green valley between Lagos and Aljezur. Find us here: https://maps.app.goo.gl/Mvt9uEBYe9jqQx3a8?g_st=ac
🥗 Maria from Essência will cook vegan food for us with lots of love, please bring some cash if you wish to eat with us, or bring your own vegan food.
